title: Bulgogi Beef Lettuce Wraps
description: Replacing cane sugar and corn syrup with minimal grated fresh pear and allulose delivers authentic Korean bulgogi flavors without glycemic volatility. Kimchi provides live lactobacilli that modulate gut inflammation.
diabeticNotes: Replacing cane sugar and corn syrup with minimal grated fresh pear and allulose delivers authentic Korean bulgogi flavors without glycemic volatility. Kimchi provides live lactobacilli that modulate gut inflammation.

ingredients.name: lean top sirloin or flank steak, sliced paper-thin across the grain
large crisp Boston Bibb or butterhead lettuce leaves

steps.title: Prepare Marinade
steps.description: In a shallow dish, whisk together tamari soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger.

steps.title: Marinate Beef
steps.description: Add thinly sliced sirloin steak to the marinade. Toss thoroughly to coat and rest for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Sear Sirloin
steps.description: Heat a heavy skillet over high heat. Sear marinated sirloin in a single layer for 2 minutes until browned.

steps.title: Prep Lettuce Cups
steps.description: Separate and wash crisp Romaine lettuce leaves. Pat dry and arrange across a serving plate.

steps.title: Assemble & Garnish
steps.description: Divide seared beef among lettuce cups. Top each cup with tangy kimchi and finely sliced scallions.
